## Introduction

This report checks the particle filter's likelihood estimate by running it many
times in `pypomp` and in R `pomp` at a single fixed parameter vector, the
published maximum likelihood estimate (MLE) that `pomp` uses as the default for
`dacca()`. Only the random seed varies across replicates, so any systematic
difference between the two would be a difference between the implementations.

```{python Load results}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import checks
from plotnine import ggplot, aes, geom_density, labs

os.environ["JAX_PLATFORMS"] = "cpu"

PLATFORMS = {
    "R pomp": os.path.join("results", "R"),
    "pypomp (GPU)": os.path.join("results", "gpu"),
}
runs = ru.load_timing_data(PLATFORMS)

py_csv = os.path.join("results", "gpu", "pfilter_logliks.csv")
r_csv = os.path.join("results", "R", "pfilter_logliks.csv")

PY = pd.read_csv(py_csv)["logLik"].values if os.path.exists(py_csv) else np.array([])
R = pd.read_csv(r_csv)["logLik"].dropna().values if os.path.exists(r_csv) else np.array([])
```


## Automated checks

```{python Automated checks, results='asis'}
M_TESTS = 2
level = checks.run_level(runs)
rows = checks.gate_smoke(
    checks.loglik_checks(PY, R, "pypomp (GPU) vs R pomp", M_TESTS),
    level,
)
checks.save(rows, level, pypomp_version=runs["pypomp (GPU)"]["meta"].get("pypomp_version"))
display(HTML(checks.table_html(rows, M_TESTS)))
```

## Summary statistics

```{python Summary table}
summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Source": ["pypomp (GPU)", "R pomp"],
    "Replicates": [len(PY), len(R)],
    "Mean": [np.mean(PY), np.mean(R)],
    "SD": [np.std(PY, ddof=1), np.std(R, ddof=1)],
    "Min": [np.min(PY), np.min(R)],
    "Median": [np.median(PY), np.median(R)],
    "Max": [np.max(PY), np.max(R)],
})

display(HTML(summary.round(3).to_html(classes="table table-striped table-hover", index=False)))
```

## Density comparison

```{python Density plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
df = pd.concat([
    pd.DataFrame({"logLik": PY, "source": "python"}),
    pd.DataFrame({"logLik": R, "source": "R"}),
], ignore_index=True)

(
    ggplot(df, aes(x="logLik", fill="source", color="source"))
    + geom_density(alpha=0.3)
    + labs(
        title="Log-likelihood density at the MLE: pypomp vs R pomp",
        subtitle="Monte Carlo variation across identical independent evaluations",
        x="Log-Likelihood", y="Density", fill="Source", color="Source",
    )
    + ru.scale_fill_premium()
    + ru.scale_color_premium()
    + ru.theme_premium
)
```
